density: Only the main heading and a short subheading. Automatically hide empty text layers, long Lorem Ipsum, paragraphs, unsupported dates and unused placeholders. Do not fill every text layer or invent wording to occupy space.
cricket_priorities: Other relevant cricket terms and key facts supported by the spoken script
evidence: Use the actual final timeline and the script words spoken during each visible text interval. Never invent a score, statistic, date, result or player. Keep numbers associated with the correct player/team/event. If the relevant information is absent or cannot fit in a short heading/subheading, hide the layer.
style: Preserve the template's existing font, text animation and motion; do not add large paragraphs. Empty reveal keyframes are not empty layers if later keyframes contain text. Protect text used as mattes and expression-driven controls.
decoration: When hiding text, also hide its owned underlines, bars, torn-paper labels and backplates. Preserve photo frames, image placeholders, shared artwork and scene backgrounds. Restore the owned decorations when a heading is restored.
coverage: A successful pass must visibly insert short script-grounded headings throughout supported scenes, not just hide sample words. Review missing-scene coverage; do not call a nearly empty result complete.
